_comment: Single source of truth for every market claim. Same discipline as docs/evidence/facts.json: nothing in the deck or the documents may state a market figure that is not in this file. Each entry is either measured (published by a named institution) or derived (computed here from measured entries, with the method written out).

ec_late_payment.text: Each year across Europe thousands of small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) go bankrupt waiting for their invoices to be paid.

beachhead_sellers.label: EU micro-enterprises selling online
beachhead_sellers.method: 32.2m EU micro-enterprises x the 21.9% online-sales rate Eurostat measures for small enterprises, rounded down to one significant figure.
beachhead_sellers.caveat: An estimate, not a measurement: Eurostat does not survey enterprises under 10 employees, so the rate is borrowed from the size class above.

adjacent_smes.label: EU micro-enterprises paid on a delay of some kind
adjacent_smes.method: All EU micro-enterprises. A marketplace payout queue, card settlement and invoice terms are the same mechanic to the forecaster: money earned and not yet received.
adjacent_smes.caveat: Upper bound for the adjacent market. Not every micro-enterprise has a material timing gap.

price_per_seller_month_eur.label: assumed price per business per month, paid by the distributor
price_per_seller_month_eur.method: Illustrative B2B2C price point: what a bank, marketplace or accounting platform pays to offer this to one business.
price_per_seller_month_eur.caveat: Assumption. No customer has been charged anything.

som_capture_pct.label: share of the beachhead assumed reachable
som_capture_pct.method: Deliberately conservative: one business in a hundred inside the beachhead.

som_annual_revenue_eur.label: annual revenue at 1% of the beachhead
som_annual_revenue_eur.caveat: Follows from the two assumptions above. Shown as arithmetic, not as a forecast.

business_model.we_charge: The distributor that benefits from a better-informed business: a bank, a marketplace, or an accounting platform, per business served per month.
business_model.we_refuse: Referral or commission from lenders. The moment a lender pays for placement, the ranking is for sale and the advice is worthless.
business_model.why_it_holds: Our incentive is that the business makes a good decision, including the decision not to borrow. A lender-funded model cannot say 'ask for an early payout instead'.
